subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward partial native images when some same-turn attachments fail, or keep the current all-or-nothing fallback until a richer source-alignment contract is implemented?
rationale: Current main has a deliberate fallback for partial failures, while the open linked PR changes user-visible channel media delivery semantics and needs maintainer intent before the issue can close.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Allow partial native image forwarding only after preserving source positions through the prompt-image boundary and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Preserve the current all-or-nothing fallback and close or narrow the linked PR if partial forwarding is not desired.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Leave both items open until a maintainer or Mantis-style proof run confirms the exact Telegram image-to-model failure on current main.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow partial native image forwarding only after preserving source positions through the prompt-image boundary and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc authored and merged the current mixed image-order contract in the same resolver, making them the clearest owner for the partial-media contract decision.
